name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8 (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU; Audio8 CPU-only), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This republish advances the pin to master 52b9abc, the single source archive shared with whisper-cpp, parakeet-cpp and audiogen-cpp. One canonical emotion / pace vocabulary now spans the engines (PR #134): tts-cpp/voice_controls.h owns the names, each engine declares the subset it supports and rejects the rest, CosyVoice3 gains per-call VoiceControls and Supertonic gains pace as a factor on its checkpoint's own default_speed. cosyvoice::EngineOptions::instruct_text is replaced by default_controls.instruct_text, so a consumer setting it must migrate. Also adds the gradchecked Supertonic vocoder backward (PR #60), test-only targets. The ggml-speech floor stays at 2026-08-07.
